svg.title: πMPC ADMM schedule and GPU work allocation
svg.desc: Six stages execute primal, projection and auxiliary, and dual updates in parallel. Dashed diagonal arrows show next-stage cached reads and previous-stage new-state reads. A global residual reduction precedes stopping and acceleration or restart. The side panel shows device-array work tiles, cooperative thread blocks, reductions and the host decision. GPU block layout is illustrative, not measured.
svg.text: Parallel stage updates · ordered phases · shared global check
Dashed diagonals: neighboring-stage reads. All blocks in an active row update in parallel.
Example tiles over the device arrays
Six visible stages · no one-stage/one-thread assumption
